text:
maya: Quick sync — customer 'AcmeHealth' hit streaming truncation on long responses in hosted API after launch. Repro steps show kv-cache eviction at ~k tokens. @alex can you triage? :eyes:
alex: on it. I saw similar in canary logs earlier. Skipping some suffix tokens when KV cache refills.
alex: repro command I used:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<long prompt>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
leila: design impact — users see mid-sentence cutoffs. Customers flagged as high priority for next week.
nate: CS says 3 customers affected, 2 on Dedicated. They're asking for timeline.
sam: severity? Are we seeing data loss or just UI truncation? Any client-side retry would restore? :thinking_face:
alex: server-side token drop. Client retry doesn't resume. Needs KV cache refactor or short-term rolling fix: force earlier flush to disk and avoid eviction mid-stream.
maya: options: 1) hotfix patch for streaming to retry/resume (low risk), 2) full KV refactor (high effort), 3) temporary routing to a more memory-rich pool for affected customers. Thoughts?
leila: users prefer immediate fix; the polish items (UX microcopy) can wait.
alex: I can scope a hotfix + canary today; estimate 1.5 engineer-days. Full refactor is 2 sprints.
sam: rolling to a memory-rich pool is ops work but quick. Might be fastest for Dedicated customers.
maya: propose: hotfix + canary for hosted, routing for Dedicated customers this week. Backlog the refactor for Q2. @nate pls confirm messaging to customers.
nate: will prepare templated note: ETA 48h for hosted patch, immediate Dedicated reroute. I'll set customer comms and SLA note.
release-bot: deploy scheduled to prod canary at 2024-12-03T17:30Z by @alex
maya: thanks. I'll update roadmap board and move 'UX polish' off urgent column. :white_check_mark:
